validation_notes: The right side of the chart (Jul-Aug) shows price flattening out around 0.07 after a prolonged downtrend, but this is better described as consolidation/basing rather than a descending triangle. There's no clear series of lower highs converging into a flat support line - the highs and lows are both fairly flat and tight (0.068-0.075 range) rather than showing a converging wedge shape. This looks more like range-bound consolidation at the bottom of a downtrend than an active triangle pattern. The algorithm may be picking up on the flat bottom, but the upper boundary isn't descending in a clear diagonal - it's roughly flat too, which would suggest a rectangle/range rather than a triangle. Insufficient converging structure to confirm a genuine descending triangle.
